headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 19, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jared Jones leading the way on the mound. Jones pitched 5.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

Injuries continue to plague several teams, with notable players including PJ Poulin (Washington Nationals), Richard Lovelady (Washington Nationals), Ryan Helsley (Baltimore Orioles), Stephen Kolek (Kansas City Royals), Justin Sterner (Athletics), Lourdes Gurriel Jr. (Arizona Diamondbacks), Jeff Criswell (Colorado Rockies), and Sal Frelick (Milwaukee Brewers) all landing on the injured list.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, including the Chicago Cubs acquiring Aaron Civale from the Athletics, the Baltimore Orioles acquiring Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals, and the St. Louis Cardinals acquiring Trey Pooser from the Tampa Bay Rays.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Guardians 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jared Jones leading the way on the mound. Jones pitched 5.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Guardians in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, snapping their opponent's winning streak. Travis Bazzana led the Guardians' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including a key 8th-inning homer that scored Steven Kwan.

top_news.title: **Cubs Cruise Past Twins 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 6-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Matthew Boyd earning the win. Kody Clemens led the Twins' offense with two home runs and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Fall to Phillies in Dominant 6-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies took down the New York Mets 6-1, with Jesús Luzardo earning the win after 5.0 IP, 7 K, 1 ER, 2 BB, 2 H. Trea Turner led the Mets with 3 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **White Sox Shut Out Blue Jays 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a dominant 3-0 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with standout performances from Colson Montgomery, Braden Montgomery, and Nathan Lukes. Trey Yesavage led the pitching effort for the winning team.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Dominate Yankees in 8-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers secured an 8-2 win over the New York Yankees, with Shohei Ohtani and Max Muncy leading the charge for the Dodgers.

top_news.title: **Nationals' PJ Poulin Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Washington Nationals left-handed pitcher PJ Poulin has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left flexor strain, effective retroactive to July 16, 2026.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Aaron Civale in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett.
